items.question: What is the Logos node programme?

answer.text: A community of independent operators running Logos nodes (blockchain, messaging and storage) to help build and decentralise the network ahead of mainnet.
No. Testnet tokens have no value. Testnet v0.3 is about stress-testing the network and getting familiar with the stack before mainnet.

items.question: Who can run a node? Do I need to be technical?

answer.text: Anyone can join. The testnet is permissionless. You can run a node with the Basecamp app or from the command line.
A modest Linux machine or VPS is enough. Full requirements are in the

items.question: Do I need tokens to start?

answer.text: No. There's no faucet: you get your first tokens by mining (EmPoWering) once your node is running.
